champion.title: The 400-page claims desks report, distilled to a model you can rotate — scale ladders
champion.pitch: Scale-ladder segmentation with cross-scale consistency: The same scene is segmented at cm, meter and site scale; verdicts require the three ladders to agree, which kills the false positives any single scale produces. Winner-DNA insight — long context + multimodal extraction judged 'best API use'; the artifact must be visual. Applied to insurance claims desks, where claim files and photos become decisions, not paperwork. Stack: SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark + Muse W

cand.title: Microfinance groups changes, measured in pixels with decimals
cand.pitch: SAM-mask geometry as numeric evidence: Segmentation masks stop being pictures: area, perimeter, count and shape-change become the numeric columns of the report, so 'did it change?' has a decimal answer. Winner-DNA insight — real-time multimodal feedback on a human performance feels like magic and demos in 60s. Applied to microfinance groups, where weekly ledgers become decisions, not paperwork. Stack: SAM 3.1 + Muse Glimmer + Muse Spark. Novel architecture

semifinalists.title: Nuskha — paper methods -> runnable recipe, executed in Modal sandboxes
semifinalists.pitch: Turn any research paper's methods section into a numbered recipe a grad student can actually run: parameter extraction, missing-steps audit (what the paper omits), environment provisioning in Modal sandboxes, execution with logged artifacts, figure reconciliation (does the remade figure match the published one), and a signed Reproduction Receipt. Stack: Wonder (1M ctx) reads the paper, Spark plans, Glimmer drafts sandbox code, Modal executes, Spark Open on Baseten grades similarity. Push the Frontier. Defending champion from round 3 (beat 10,568 ideas).
